Container.Name: afterglow-tv
Container.Overview: Afterglow TV turns your Plex libraries into deterministic linear television channels, with a full guide, live tuning, catch-up, favorites and broadcast presentation. Plex provides the media; Afterglow maintains its own local inventory and schedules. Set the Browser Origin to the exact URL you use to open Afterglow. The optional Android TV APK is standalone and does not require this container. Beta: hardware and network compatibility varies.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: Plex IPTV EPG linear television Android TV Shield
Container.Requires: Plex Media Server and library access. Set Browser Origin before first launch. Appdata must be writable by UID 99 / GID 100.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Browser port. Match this port in Browser Origin.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, encrypted credentials, encryption material, uploads and cache. Back up this entire directory together.

Config.Name: Browser Origin
Config.Description: REQUIRED: replace with the exact browser URL, for example http://tower:8080 or your Unraid LAN IP and mapped port. No trailing slash. HTTPS reverse proxies must use their public HTTPS origin.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Use true only with an HTTPS Browser Origin.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: DEBUG, INFO, WARN or ERROR. Do not share unredacted diagnostics.

Config.Name: Upload Limit MB
Config.Description: Maximum size of each compatible presentation video upload.
